description: Detects a process other than chrome.exe whose command line references Chrome's synced-passkey LevelDB store, indicating passkey enumeration/theft (Unit42 Pass-ta-key).
references:
  - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/passwordless-authentication-security-risks/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/08/03
tags:
  - attack.t1217
  - attack.t1555.003
  - attack.credential_access
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - '\Google\Chrome\User Data'
      - 'Sync Data\LevelDB'
  filter_chrome:
    Image|endswith: '\chrome.exe'
  condition: selection and not filter_chrome
level: high
2805.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.file_path="*\\Google\\Chrome\\User Data*Sync Data\\LevelDB*" AND NOT Filesystem.process_name="chrome.exe" by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user Filesystem.process_name Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.action | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | where NOT process_name IN ("MsMpEng.exe","MsSense.exe","SearchIndexer.exe","SearchProtocolHost.exe","GoogleUpdate.exe") | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
2805.falcon:
#event_simpleName=FileOpenInfo
| TargetFileName=/\\Google\\Chrome\\User Data\\.*\\Sync Data\\LevelDB\\/i
| ContextImageFileName!=/\\chrome\.exe$/i
| ContextImageFileName!=/\\(MsMpEng|MsSense|SearchIndexer|SearchProtocolHost|GoogleUpdate)\.exe$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, TargetFileName], function=count())

2806.def:
union
( DeviceFileEvents
  | where Timestamp > ago(14d)
  | where FileName in~ ("passkey_enclave_state","wrapped_identity_private_key")
  | where FolderPath has @"\Google\Chrome\User Data"
  | where InitiatingProcessFileName !~ "chrome.exe"
  | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName=InitiatingProcessAccountName, Actor=InitiatingProcessFileName, ActorCmd=InitiatingProcessCommandLine, Target=FolderPath, File=FileName ),
( DeviceProcessEvents
  | where Timestamp > ago(14d)
  | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("passkey_enclave_state","wrapped_identity_private_key")
  | where InitiatingProcessFileName !~ "chrome.exe" and FileName !~ "chrome.exe"
  | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, Actor=InitiatingProcessFileName, ActorCmd=InitiatingProcessCommandLine, Target=ProcessCommandLine, File=FileName )
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where Actor !in~ ("MsMpEng.exe","MsSense.exe","SearchIndexer.exe","SearchProtocolHost.exe","GoogleUpdate.exe","elevation_service.exe")
| order by Timestamp desc
2806.sent:
union
( SecurityEvent
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
  | where EventID == 4688
  | where CommandLine has_any ("passkey_enclave_state","wrapped_identity_private_key")
  | where NewProcessName !endswith "\\chrome.exe"
  | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
  | project TimeGenerated, Computer, User=SubjectUserName, Actor=NewProcessName, Cmd=CommandLine ),
( Event
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
  | where Source == "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon" and EventID == 11
  | where EventData has_any ("passkey_enclave_state","wrapped_identity_private_key")
  | where EventData !has "chrome.exe"
  | project TimeGenerated, Computer, User="", Actor="sysmon-filecreate", Cmd=EventData )
| order by TimeGenerated desc

let lookback = 24h;
let extractionThreshold = 100;   // 100 = bulk-pull floor; a single interactive portal session rarely hits >100 successful /_api calls
ImWebSession

| order by Requests desc

title: Anonymous Bulk Access to Power Pages Web API / OData Dataverse Endpoints
id: 3f2a1c9e-8b47-4d6a-bf21-7c9e5a1d2b30
status: experimental
description: Detects requests to Microsoft Power Pages Web API (/_api/) or legacy OData (/_odata) routes that expose Dataverse table data, as abused by ExfilSquad against misconfigured Anonymous Users web roles (PNLD and related breaches).
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/08/pnld-breach-exposes-uk-police-and.html
  - https://venarix.com/blog/exfilsquad-targets-misconfigured-microsoft-power-pages-portals
  - https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-pages/configure/web-api-overview
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/08/03
tags:
  - attack.collection
  - attack.t1213
  - attack.t1190
logsource:
  category: webserver
detection:
  selection:
    cs-uri-stem|contains:
      - '/_api/'
      - '/_odata'
      - '/_services/'
    sc-status: 200
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - Authenticated portal users or integration service accounts retrieving records via the Web API
  - Portal client-side JavaScript rendering list/grid pages for a single browsing session
level: medium
2807.spl:
| tstats `summariesonly` count as requests, sum(Web.bytes_out) as total_bytes_out, dc(Web.url) as distinct_urls, min(_time) as firstTime, max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Web where (Web.url="*/_api/*" OR Web.url="*/_odata*" OR Web.url="*/_services/*") Web.status=200 by Web.src, Web.http_user_agent, Web.dest
| `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`
| where requests > 100
| eval firstTime=strftime(firstTime,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), lastTime=strftime(lastTime,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
| sort - requests

2808.sent:
let lookback = 24h;
ImWebSession
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where Url contains "/_api/" or Url contains "/_odata"   // Power Pages Web API / legacy OData entity-set access
| extend Status = coalesce(HttpStatusCode, HttpResponseCode)
| extend EntitySet = tostring(extract(@"/_(?:api|odata)/([A-Za-z0-9_]+)", 1, Url))
| where isnotempty(EntitySet)
| summarize DistinctEntitySets = dcount(EntitySet),
            EntitySets = make_set(EntitySet, 40),
            Allowed = countif(Status == 200),
            Denied = countif(Status in (401, 403, 404)),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
    by SrcIpAddr, HttpRequestHeaderUserAgent, DstHostname
| where DistinctEntitySets >= 5   // 5+ distinct Dataverse tables probed by one source = enumeration, not normal browsing
| order by DistinctEntitySets desc
2808.spl:
| tstats `summariesonly` count, dc(Web.uri_path) as distinct_paths, values(Web.status) as statuses, min(_time) as firstTime, max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Web where (Web.url="*/_api/*" OR Web.url="*/_odata*") by Web.src, Web.http_user_agent, Web.dest
| `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`
| where distinct_paths >= 5
| eval firstTime=strftime(firstTime,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), lastTime=strftime(lastTime,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
| sort - distinct_paths

2810.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — N-able Says Attackers Take Over N-central Servers After Initial Fix Proves Incom
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FolderPath has_any ("C:\ProgramData\GetSupportService_N-Central\Logs\BASupSrvc_"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FolderPath has_any ("C:\ProgramData\GetSupportService_N-Central\Logs\BASupSrvc_"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

description: Detects the prototype-pollution exploit request for CVE-2026-53609 - a PATCH to an ApostropheCMS piece-type REST endpoint carrying __proto__/$pullAll/publicApiProjection keys.
references:
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-6h5j-32cf-4253

author: SOC Detection Engineering

detection:
  selection_method:

    keywords:
      - '__proto__'
      - '$pullAll'
      - 'publicApiProjection'
  condition: selection_method and selection_path and selection_payload

2833.spl:
| tstats `summariesonly` count values(Web.status) as status min(_time) as firstSeen max(_time) as lastSeen from datamodel=Web where Web.http_method=PATCH Web.url="*/api/v1/@apostrophecms/*" (Web.url="*__proto__*" OR Web.url="*$pullAll*" OR Web.url="*publicApiProjection*" OR Web.uri_query="*__proto__*" OR Web.uri_query="*publicApiProjection*") by Web.src Web.dest Web.url Web.http_user_agent

2834.sent:
let lookback = 3d;
let loggedInIPs = AppServiceHTTPLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
    | where CsUriStem has "/api/v1/@apostrophecms/login/login" and ScStatus == 200
    | distinct CIp;
AppServiceHTTPLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where CsMethod =~ "GET"
| where CsUriStem in~ ("/api/v1/@apostrophecms/user","/api/v1/@apostrophecms/global")
| where CIp !in (loggedInIPs)   // never authenticated -> should never get 200
| summarize AuthFailures = countif(ScStatus in (401,403)),
            Successes = countif(ScStatus == 200),
            LastAuthFail = maxif(TimeGenerated, ScStatus in (401,403)),
            FirstSuccess = minif(TimeGenerated, ScStatus == 200)
            by CIp, CsUriStem
| where Successes > 0 and FirstSuccess > coalesce(LastAuthFail, datetime(1970-01-01))
| project CIp, CsUriStem, AuthFailures, Successes, LastAuthFail, FirstSuccess
| order by Successes desc
2834.spl:
| tstats `summariesonly` min(_time) as first max(_time) as last count from datamodel=Web where Web.http_method=GET Web.url="*/api/v1/@apostrophecms/*" (Web.status=200 OR Web.status=401 OR Web.status=403) by Web.src Web.uri_path Web.status
| `drop_dm_object_name("Web")`
| eval failTime=if(status=="401" OR status=="403", last, null()), succTime=if(status=="200", first, null())
| stats max(failTime) as LastAuthFail min(succTime) as FirstSuccess sum(count) as Hits by src uri_path
| where isnotnull(LastAuthFail) AND isnotnull(FirstSuccess) AND FirstSuccess > LastAuthFail
| eval GapSeconds=FirstSuccess-LastAuthFail
| convert ctime(LastAuthFail) ctime(FirstSuccess)
| sort - Hits

2835.sent:
let win = 30s;
let lookback = 2d;
let loggedInIPs = AppServiceHTTPLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
    | where CsUriStem has "/api/v1/@apostrophecms/login/login" and ScStatus == 200
    | distinct CIp;
let patches = AppServiceHTTPLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
    | where CsMethod =~ "PATCH" and CsUriStem startswith "/api/v1/@apostrophecms/"
    | where CIp !in (loggedInIPs)
    | project PatchTime = TimeGenerated, CIp, PatchUri = CsUriStem;
AppServiceHTTPLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where CsMethod =~ "GET" and ScStatus == 200
| where CsUriStem in~ ("/api/v1/@apostrophecms/user","/api/v1/@apostrophecms/global")
| where CIp !in (loggedInIPs)
| join kind=inner patches on CIp
| where TimeGenerated between (PatchTime .. PatchTime + win)
| project PatchTime, GetTime = TimeGenerated, DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', TimeGenerated, PatchTime), CIp, PatchUri, GetUri = CsUriStem
| order by PatchTime desc
2835.spl:
| tstats `summariesonly` min(_time) as GetTime from datamodel=Web where Web.http_method=GET Web.status=200 (Web.uri_path="/api/v1/@apostrophecms/user" OR Web.uri_path="/api/v1/@apostrophecms/global") by Web.src Web.uri_path
| `drop_dm_object_name("Web")`
| join type=inner src [
    | tstats `summariesonly` max(_time) as PatchTime from datamodel=Web where Web.http_method=PATCH Web.url="*/api/v1/@apostrophecms/*" by Web.src
    | `drop_dm_object_name("Web")` ]
| where GetTime >= PatchTime AND GetTime <= (PatchTime + 30)
| eval DelaySec = GetTime - PatchTime
| convert ctime(PatchTime) ctime(GetTime)
| table src uri_path PatchTime GetTime DelaySec

description: Detects 'python3 -m http.server 8888', the ad-hoc web server the Hermes AI attack agent started from /home/worker, exposing API keys, exploit scripts and target lists.
references:
  - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/autonomous-ai-cyber-attack-campaign/
  - https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/08/03/deepseek-ai-autonomous-cyberattacks-hermes-agent/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/08/06
tags:
  - attack.t1071.001
  - attack.t1608.001
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: linux
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/python3'
      - '/python'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'http.server'
      - '8888'
  condition: selection
level: high
2879.spl:
| tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process="*http.server*8888*" AND Processes.process_name IN ("python3","python") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
2879.falcon:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\/python3?$/i CommandLine=/http\.server.*8888/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, CommandLine], function=count())

2884.sigma:
title: Excessively Long High-Entropy DNS Query Label (Possible Tunneling)
id: 8f3c1a54-6d21-4c9e-9b3a-2f7e5d0a1c44
description: Flags a single DNS query whose leading label is >=60 characters of base32/base64/hex-like characters, a hallmark of name-encoded DNS tunneling / exfiltration as described in KATA NAD.
references:
  - https://securelist.com/tr/network-anomaly-detection-in-kata/120892/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/08/06
tags:
  - attack.command_and_control
  - attack.t1071.004
  - attack.t1572
logsource:
  category: dns
detection:
  selection:
    query|re: '(?i)^[a-z0-9+/=_-]{60,}\.'
  condition: selection
level: medium
2884.spl:
| tstats `summariesonly` count from datamodel=Network_Resolution.DNS by DNS.src DNS.query
| `drop_dm_object_name(DNS)`
| eval qlen=len(query)
| where qlen>50
| rex field=query "(?<parent>[a-z0-9-]+\.[a-z0-9-]+)$"
| stats dc(query) as unique_subqueries sum(count) as total_queries max(qlen) as max_label_len by src parent
| where unique_subqueries>50 AND max_label_len>100
| sort - unique_subqueries
2884.falcon:
#event_simpleName=DnsRequest
| DomainName=/^[a-z0-9+\/=_-]{50,}\./i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName], function=count(field=DomainName, distinct=true, as=unique_subdomains))
| unique_subdomains > 50

2980.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — Compromised PyPI Package: mrmustard 0.7.4 Steals SSH, Cloud, and Kubernetes Cred
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("__init__.py"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FolderPath has_any ("/usr/bin/env", "/home/runner/.cache/.tf_cache/hw_probe.pyc", "/dev/null") or FileName in~ ("__init__.py"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
2980.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — Compromised PyPI Package: mrmustard 0.7.4 Steals SSH, Cloud, and Kubernetes Cred ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("__init__.py"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified")
      AND (Filesystem.file_path="*/usr/bin/env*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/home/runner/.cache/.tf_cache/hw_probe.pyc*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/dev/null*" OR Filesystem.file_name IN ("__init__.py"))
    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user, Filesystem.process_name,
       Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
]
